name: Head of Pikari Cleaning
source:
The president of "Pikari Cleaning".
A worldly-wise man who is devoted to his job and the owner of the largest company in the cleaning field.
He has absolute confidence in his own vinyl floor tile cleaning technology. Due to his age he doesn't appear on the field that often anymore.

Things that he worries about: His daughter coming home very late every day.
Dreams for the future: He wishes that the cleaning cycle will be prolonged despite the recent economic downturn. He wants his company to stay the strongest in its field...~and so on and so forth~

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
